sources.title: Tamagotchi Paradise - Neon Planets | ITEM | たまごっち公式サイト
sources.snippet:
ぐるぐる育てて大発見！あなただけのたまごっちパラダイスを育てよう！  
   
 ズームダイヤルを回して細胞レベルから銀河レベルでたまごっちをお世話！   
 これまでの『Tamagotchi Paradise』の宇宙から細胞までの４階層に加え、「Neon Planets」には「たまギャラクシー段階」が新登場。  
 複数の惑星を切り替えて遊べる「プラネットきりかえ」機能も追加され、より壮大なお世話が楽しめるようになりました。   
   
 遊べる惑星は「コズミック星」「にゅーたまごっち星」「たまごっち星」の３つ！   
 Neon Planetsデバイスは、「コズミック星」から遊びがスタートします。  
 「にゅーたまごっち星」では、パラダイスシリーズの人気たまごっちを、「たまごっち星」では、懐かしのたまごっちたちを育てることができます。   
   
 ●ぐるぐる育ててズームでお世話！   
 ズームダイヤルを回して細胞レベルから銀河レベルまで幅広くお世話！   
 生まれた「たまギャラクシー」からズームして、たまごっちを育てる「わくせい」を選択！ [...] おいしいごはんを食べさせて、フィールドのうんちを片付けて、病気の細胞を治療して、さらに「ラボモード」でミニゲームやお買い物、図鑑まで！？   
 たまごっちのお世話はかつてないほど大忙し！   
   
 ●出会えるたまごっちは50,000種以上！   
 環境やお世話の仕方によって、12種族、50以上のたまごっちに成長。   
 ブリードして遺伝することで、さらに多種多様な姿に！   
 さらに！おなじみのたまごっちたちもパラダイスに登場！？   
 たまごっち30周年を記念して、懐かしのたまごっちたちを育てられる「たまごっち星」も！   
   
 ●何が起きるかわからないドキドキのツーしん！   
 たまごっちデバイスをドッキングしてツーしん！   
 相性が良いと子どもが誕生、相性が悪いと…？   
 さらに、「ツーしんミニゲーム」では、ともだちと一緒にツーしんで協力・対戦ミニゲームが楽しめる！ [...] ※ツーしんミニゲームはPink Land,Blue Water, Purple Sky, Purple Sky 竹下☆ぱらだいす＆しなこスペシャルセット, Jade Forestではプレイできません。  
   
 ●別売りのMy Lab Tamagotchiとも超連動！  
 My Lab Tamagotchiとツーしんすると、遊びがさらに広がる！  
➀つくったオリジナルアイテムをてんそう   
 ➁おにわにいるたまごっちとブリード   
 ➂シミュレーションした姿になるかもしれないスペシャルフードをてんそう   
 ➃育てたたまごっちをMy Lab Tamagotchiのおにわにリリース  
 など、4つの遊びが広がります！   
 ※Pink Land, Blue Water, Purple Sky, Purple Sky 竹下☆ぱらだいす＆しなこスペシャルセット, Jade Forest, Orange Tropics, White Glacierでは➂と➃はできません。  
  
 たまごっちのお世話も研究も、もっともっとやりこもう！

Depending on the environment and how you care for it, it can grow into 12 different species and over 50 tamagotchi.

  And what's more! The familiar tamagotchi will also be appearing in Paradise!?    
  To commemorate tamagotchi 30th anniversary, there's also " tamagotchi Planet," where you can raise your beloved tamagotchi ! [...] Grow them around and make great discoveries! Create your very own tamagotchi paradise!    
   
  Turn the zoom dial to care for tamagotchi from the cellular level to the galaxy level!    
  In addition to the four levels from space to cells in the previous "Tamagotchi Paradise," "Neon Planets" introduces a new "Tama Galaxy level."    
  A "Planet Switching" feature has been added, allowing you to switch between multiple planets and enjoy an even grander level of caregiving. [...] Turn the zoom dial to access a wide range of information, from cellular levels to galaxy levels!    
  Zoom in on the newly hatched "Tama Galaxy" and select the "planet" where you'll raise tamagotchi!    
  Feed them delicious food, clean up the poop in the field, treat diseased cells, and even play mini-games, shop, and explore a picture book in "Lab Mode"!?    
  Taking care of a tamagotchi is busier than ever!    
   
  ●There are over 50,000 types of tamagotchi to discover!

sources.title: [Pre-Order] Tamagotchi Paradise - Neon Planets [NOV 21 2026] – JYW TMGC
sources.snippet:
Raise and discover! Grow your very own Tamagotchi Paradise with the new Neon Planets!

Raise your Tamagotchi by zooming in and out, from the cell level all the way to the galaxy level! In addition to the four levels of the previous Tamagotchi Paradise models, from space to cells, Neon Planets adds a brand-new "Tama Galaxy" level. With the new "Planet Switch" feature, you can switch between multiple planets for an even bigger adventure in caring for your Tamagotchi. [...] Over 50,000 Tamagotchi to discover! Depending on the environment and how you care for them, they grow into more than 50 Tamagotchi across 12 species. Breeding and inheritance create even more variations. To celebrate the 30th anniversary of Tamagotchi, "Tamagotchi Planet" lets you raise nostalgic Tamagotchi characters, too! [...] Zoom in and out to care for your Tamagotchi! Turn the zoom dial to care for your Tamagotchi from the cell level to the galaxy level. Zoom in from your "Tama Galaxy" and choose the planet where you want to raise your Tamagotchi. Feed them tasty food, clean up poop on the field, treat sick cells, and enjoy mini-games, shopping and even a character encyclopedia in "Lab Mode"!

sources.title: Tamagotchi Paradise | Tamagotchi Wiki | Fandom
sources.snippet:
- Neon Planets: The fourth version of the Tamagotchi Paradise, set to release worldwide on November 21, 2026. This version has an additional fifth zoom level called the "Tama Galaxy" level, and rather than maintaining three different fields on one planet, this version instead re-imagines the gameplay to be maintaining three different planets with their own single field. In addition to new characters and environments, the food, items, and games are also modified to match the themes. It also [...] it offers unique functionality with the Neon Planets version, with users able to send exclusive food to be able to raise their simulated offspring on the Paradise device, as well as being able to release their Tamas onto the My Lab Tamagotchi to live in the Garden permanently. [...] - Galaxy View: Exclusive to the Neon Planets version. View the state of three different planets at an intergalactic level.
- Space View: View the state of New Tamagotchi Planet at a cosmic level. Functions: Clock, Connection, Tama Stars, Deco Planet, Travel, and Planet Lv.
- Field View: View the state of the land and see Tamagotchi roaming around and interacting with placed objects. Functions: Place Outside Toys, Egg Hunt, Clean Poop, and Change Field.
